body.statement: At every interior parameter, \(I_{\mathcal U}(\eta)\) is positive definite and \(V_{\mathrm{eff}}(\eta)\) is the semiparametric efficiency bound coefficient for estimating \(\theta(\eta)\) in the product-Poisson experiment as \(\kappa\to\infty\). The least-favorable local direction is the efficient target score obtained by projecting the treated-total score onto the orthocomplement of the untreated row-plus-time nuisance score space.
body.justification: The explicit nuisance projection identifies the regular benchmark that exact sparse-count procedures must approach.
body.gap: Martin (2017), Theorem 2, and Wooldridge (2023) provide regular fixed-\(T\) inference for different panel targets; neither derives this counterfactual-share ratio's exact aggregate-Poisson efficiency bound.
body.consumer: High-volume staggered-PPML applications obtain a principled variance formula and a least-favorable direction for calibration and power analysis.
